explication: This tree spans several Modular Platform products rather than one end-to-end application: MAX model pipelines and runtime, the graph compiler, Mojo compilation and execution, and supporting asynchronous/runtime and cache libraries. The visible MAX workflow starts at the `max` pipelines entry point and resolves a model pipeline; the C++ engine context compiles and initializes models, then executes them. The README establishes the broader product capabilities, but many subsystems are represented only by the tree, so their internal links are omitted rather than inferred.
